THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Revocation of Order under Section 4(1)

WHEREAS by Order made under Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments ofCeylon (Revised Edition 1956), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 and 62 of 1957, 14 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 read with IndustrialDisputes (Special Provisions) Act, No. 37 of 1968 dated 04.01.2018 and published in the Gazette of the Democratic SocialistRepublic of Sri Lanka Extraordinary No. 2053/25 dated 10.01.2018 of the Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified inthe statement of the Commissioner of Labour dated 22.12.2017.
Mr. K. Nawaratnerajah, No. 27/16, Tangalle Road, Samagipura, Hambantota.
AND
Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC, No. 110, Norris Canal Road, Colombo 10.
was referred to Mr. P. Nawaratne for settlement by arbitration.

AND whereas it is now deemed expedient that the said Order be revoked, I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour andTrade Union Relations do hereby revoke the said Order and further make Order that no proceedings be taken upon the saidOrder dated 04.01.2018.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.07th February, 2019.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Order under Section 4(1)
WHEREAS an Industrial Dispute in respect of the matter specified in the statement of the Commissioner General of Labourwhich accompanies this order exists between–
Mr. K. Nawaratnerajah, No. 27/16, Tangalle Road, Samagipura, Hambantota.
AND
Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC, No. 110, Norris Canal Road, Colombo 10.

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Samaraweera, Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations do by virtue of the powersvested in me by Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon (1956 RevisedEdition), as amended by Acts, Nos. 14 of 1957, 4 of 1962 and 39 of 1968 (read with Industrial Disputes - Special Provisions) Act,No. 37 of 1968 hereby appoint Mr. P. Nawaratne, No. 570/B/1, Ekamuthu Mawatha, Off Nugegoda Road, Thalawathugoda to bethe arbitrator and refer the aforesaid dispute to him for settlement by arbitration.
RAVINDRA SAMARAWEERA,Minister of Labour and Trade Union Relations.
Colombo.07th February, 2019.
THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. K. Nawaratnerajah, No. 27/16, Tangalle Road, Samagipura, Hambantota.
AND
Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC, No. 110, Norris Canal Road, Colombo 10.
STATEMENT OF MATTER IN DISPUTE
The matter in dispute between the aforesaid parties is–

Whether Mr. K. Nawaratne Rajah who worked as the Security Guard of Distilleries Company of Sri Lanka PLC – whole saleoutlet, Ambalantota had been caused injustice by the non-payment of overtime from 2004 to 2010 and the non-payment from2004 to 2010, the allowance promised for the tranport of rice powder purchased from different places by the lorries of theCompany according to the order of the Head of the Institution to the Ambewela Animal Farm, and if such injustice had beencaused, to what relief he is entitled.
A. WIMALAWEERA,Commissioner General of Labour.
Dated at the Office of the Commissioner of Labour,Colombo this 23rd day of January, 2019.

THE INDUSTRIAL DISPUTES ACT, CHAPTER 131 OF THE LEGISLATIVE ENACTMENTS OF CEYLON( 1956 REVISED EDITION)
Mr. P. B. Manjula Prasad, Sub-Warden, Student Services Division, Sabaragamuwa University, Belihuloya.
AND
Sabaragamuwa University of Sri Lanka, P. O. Box 02, Belihuloya.
